nodes.label: MiniMax Design System
nodes.rationale: Premium AI infrastructure brand identity: stark white canvas with deep-black typographic emphasis for marketing, paired with vibrant gradient product cards that give each model its own visual personality.

nodes.label: Dual Identity Branding
nodes.rationale: Marketing and platform pages stay monochrome and editorial; each model release gets a saturated gradient identity card so product lines read like distinct album covers on the homepage.

nodes.label: DM Sans
nodes.rationale: Chosen for dual fluency: scales from 80px hero displays with -2px letter-spacing to 12px micro labels; emphasis via weight (500/600/700) rather than italics; Inter as fallback.

nodes.label: Black Pill CTA
nodes.rationale: Dominant interactive signature: rounded-full black primary pills; outline secondary; brand colors reserved for product-identity moments only.

nodes.label: Product Color Encoding
nodes.rationale: Each model line has a fixed brand color: coral M2.7, magenta Music 2.6, blue Hailuo, purple Speech 2.8 — brand assignments, not free choices.

nodes.label: Vibrant Product Cards
nodes.rationale: 32px hero radius and saturated backgrounds distinguish featured product moments from quiet 16px white documentation cards.

nodes.label: Flat Elevation System
nodes.rationale: System runs predominantly flat; elevation reserved for sticky panels, dropdowns, and rare floating CTAs. Vibrant cards rely on color depth rather than shadows.

nodes.label: MailOG
nodes.rationale: Standalone paperless correspondence management with full audit trail; modular so external API integration does not require architectural rewrite.

nodes.label: MiniMax Design Language for MailOG
nodes.rationale: Adapts MiniMax visual identity for formal government/institution context: monochrome dominant with accent colors for status; design_ref points to MiniMax-design-analysis.

nodes.label: RBAC
nodes.rationale: Five-level role model prevents staff from seeing other units' internal letters; middleware on every route plus unit tests mitigate misconfiguration data leaks.

nodes.label: Separate Surat Tables Decision
nodes.rationale: surat_masuk and surat_keluar could merge into one surat table with jenis enum; for early phase, separate tables are cleaner for Drizzle schema.

nodes.label: Lampiran
nodes.rationale: MinIO as single source of truth for attachments; no public bucket — access only via 1-hour presigned URLs.

nodes.label: Tracking Log / Audit Trail
nodes.rationale: Every data mutation must be recorded; soft delete only; IP and user agent captured on each action.

nodes.label: MinIO
nodes.rationale: S3-compatible object storage for attachments; risk if down mitigated by secondary backup and caching file info in DB.

nodes.label: Local Storage Driver
nodes.rationale: Default STORAGE_DRIVER=local; if MinIO fails on upload/read, system falls back to local folder.

nodes.label: MailOG Favicon
nodes.rationale: 32x32 browser-tab brand mark; neon blue on black maximizes contrast at tiny size

nodes.label: Neon Outline Style
nodes.rationale: Electric blue glowing outlines on solid black convey a digital/tech-first brand; linear minimal geometry remains legible at favicon resolution

nodes.label: Outlined Line-Art Style
nodes.rationale: All shapes use stroke-only rendering with fill=none for a flat outlined icon suitable as a small favicon.
